findings.title_text: 6 vouchers have a narration matching a configured re-issue/amendment/transfer term
limits_text: A narration match is not proof that a sale was actually re-issued, amended or transferred; some other administrative meaning may explain the same word.
ask_client_text: For each of these, confirm whether an earlier invoice for the same supply was formally cancelled in Tally before this one was raised.
Confirm whether any of these fall outside the s.34(2) credit-note window (30 November following the financial year).
